purpose: Schema only, not an observed NATVIEW result. Replace fields only from actual reviewed outputs.
natview_note: research_notes/Clinical EEG fMRI thesis exploration/NATVIEW experiments.md

natview_panel.scope: Replace with actual confirmation N, protocol/condition and exclusion of ingestion pilot; max two short lines.
natview_panel.metric_label: Replace with actual target and metric; do not borrow ds006040 target definition.
natview_panel.coverage_caption: Replace with eligible/attempted frame coverage against all eight reserved people; never use pilot 134/288 as confirmation coverage.
natview_panel.montage_caption: 23 target sites include specified interpolation; not 23 shared measured channels.
natview_panel.qc_caption: Keep original v1 1/8 QC result; v2 is an amendment, not untouched confirmation.
natview_panel.failure_caption: Use only for a completed QC failure with no defensible transfer estimate. Describe what prevented scoring.

rules: Keep separate N/CI/scale from ds006040. Set prediction metrics only when justified; QC failure does not require an invented point. Coordinator must confirm NATVIEW and final report review.
